title: The economics of open source by C J Silverio | JSConf EU 2019
summary: C J Silverio, former npm CTO, explains how the JavaScript package commons ended up in the hands of a for-profit company with no accountability. She discusses the cost of running a registry and what the community should do next.
why: HN recommends it as the best account of what is wrong with npm's governance and why alternative or decentralized registries are hard.

quote.text: For those wondering what's wrong with npm, I can recommend this C J Silverio talk
